title: Preserve creature hit point formulas alongside average HP
description:
Scope:
- Preserve printed creature hit point formulas such as "19d12 + 133".
- Fable quantified 316 dropped HP formulas.
- Align with stat-block hitPoints { value, formula } where possible.

Acceptance criteria:
- Creature hitPoints carries both average/value and formula when the SRD prints a formula.
- All 316 HP formulas are represented.
- Deterministic tools can roll or compute min/max HP variants without parsing prose.
- Add regression coverage for simple formulas, formulas with modifiers, and large hit-dice formulas.
close_reason: Implemented in PR #394: hitPoints modeled as {value, formula} matching the stat-block kind; all 317 printed formulas preserved (source-verified every Hit Points line); fidelity gate validates formula grammar + floored-mean math; regression coverage for no-modifier, modifier, and large hit-dice formulas.
